claims.sentence: (1) Objective: This study examined the effects of a combined intervention of Brainastic computerized cognitive training (CCT) preceded by physical exercise (PE) for improving frailty status and cognitive function in older adults. (2) Methods: Older adults aged 50 years or older attending elderly centers, without frailty/history of cognitive impairment, were randomly allocated into either a 12-week (i) multi-domain CCT + PE ( n = 117), (ii) two-domain CCT + PE ( n = 116) or (iii) video watching + PE (i.e., control, n = 114).
